prompt: I need to create a new Angular component for a user profile page. It should display user info, have an edit form, and show a list of their recent orders. The component needs to fetch the user data from an API and handle loading/error states. Can you create src/app/features/profile/user-profile.component.ts for me?
assertions: Component uses inject() instead of constructor injection
Component uses signal-based inputs (input() function) if it has inputs
Component uses signal() or computed() for local/derived state
Component uses resource() or httpResource() for data fetching, OR uses toSignal() with an observable
Component is standalone (standalone: true or no modules)
